summary: V50.z554 Manual + Assistant how-to injection tested on both backend (preview) and frontend (web). Backend /api/public/manual + /api/public/manual/search work correctly on preview backend (145 articles across 10 categories; Italian search returns relevant, score-ordered results for 'scanner', 'nota vocale', 'landing page', 'come creo un contatto', 'calendario appuntamenti', 'fatture energia', 'axon lab'; empty/nonsense queries handled gracefully). Manual injection into assistant prompt is wired (logs confirm '[manual] prompt: N articoli → ...' every how-to message). HOWEVER two blocker issues surfaced during live chat tests: (A) /api/assistant/chat returns 'Sono temporaneamente offline' for the Italian how-to queries 'Come creo un contatto', 'Come registro una nota vocale', 'Dove si configura la landing page' because ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env is INVALID (format 'apikey_01A3...' instead of required 'sk-ant-...' → litellm AuthenticationError 'invalid x-api-key' on every Claude call). Only queries that hit the programmatic axon_navigator fast-path (e.g. 'dove trovo lo scanner') succeed and return a valid NAV chip. (B) The frontend web preview is configured to call the production VPS (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://core.axonos.cloud) which does NOT yet have /api/public/manual deployed → /manuale screen renders empty (0 categories, 0 articles) and search returns nothing. Both issues are blocking for the user-visible rollout of this feature. Frontend route plumbing is correct (manuale-screen, manual-cat-*, manual-article-*, manual-open-*, manual-search-input/clear, manuale-back, help-center → help-manual → /manuale, assistant-fab → assistant-input → assistant-send → nav-chip-0 → navigation). Additional minor bug: /manuale?q=<query> correctly autofocuses the TextInput but does NOT pre-populate the input value (only autoFocus flag is forwarded, the q value is dropped).

critical.issue: LLM calls fail with AnthropicException 'invalid x-api-key' for every how-to message that isn't short-circuited by axon_navigator. User sees 'Sono temporaneamente offline, riprova tra qualche minuto.' Root cause: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env has value 'apikey_01A3Dnnn7WvZLVv7WaRWzBgE' which Anthropic rejects as unauthorized (expected prefix 'sk-ant-'). This breaks 3 of the 4 required review-request how-to prompts: 'Come creo un contatto', 'Come registro una nota vocale', 'Dove si configura la landing page'. The manual-prompt injection itself is working (log line '[manual] prompt: N articoli → ...' is emitted correctly) but the downstream Claude call never succeeds.

Returns 404 — the V50.z554 axon_manual routes are not deployed on the production VPS that the Expo web preview talks to by default (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL). Consequence: the /manuale screen is EMPTY in the user-visible app (0 categories, 0 articles, search returns nothing). Preview backend has them (200 OK, 145 articles).

minor.issue: Stream endpoint responds 200 and emits SSE chunks but under the same invalid-key regime it only streams the offline-fallback text. Once the Anthropic key is fixed, re-verify that chips are emitted mid-stream.

ui_bugs.issue: /manuale?q=scanner correctly triggers autoFocus on the TextInput but the input is empty — the q value is NOT forwarded as initial text. Code only passes `autoFocus={!!q}` to <ManualBrowser>, never the `q` string. Expected: value={scanner} and immediate search.

On the deployed Expo web preview the screen renders with 0 categories/0 articles because the frontend talks to core.axonos.cloud (VPS) which has not received the V50.z554 backend deployment. This is a deployment issue, not a code bug, but it directly affects the user flow the review request is asking to test.
Fallback route when stack is empty is `/help` but the real screen the user came from in this feature is `/help-center`. Minor inconsistency.

integration_issues.issue: WORKS. Tap help-manual on /help-center correctly routes to /manuale.
Could not fully verify end-to-end because categories/articles failed to load (see critical issue above). Component code (manual-open-* → router.push(resolveNavRoute(a.route))) is well-formed.

WORKS for 'Dove trovo lo scanner biglietti da visita?' — [[NAV:/scanner|Apri Scanner documenti / OCR]] is rendered as nav-chip-0 and tapping it navigates to /scanner. Could NOT verify for the other 3 how-to prompts because of the invalid Anthropic key (see critical).

action_items: URGENT: Fix ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env — current value 'apikey_01A3Dnnn7WvZLVv7WaRWzBgE' is rejected by Anthropic (needs 'sk-ant-...' prefix). This is the root cause of 'Sono temporaneamente offline' on every real LLM reply, breaking 3/4 of the review-request how-to prompts. Confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: 'AnthropicException - invalid x-api-key' (hundreds of occurrences).

URGENT: Deploy V50.z554 (axon_manual.py + axon_manual_data.py routes) to the production VPS core.axonos.cloud. Currently /api/public/manual returns 404 there, which is what the deployed Expo web preview actually calls (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL takes priority over EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/src/api.ts). Until this ships, the /manuale screen is empty for real users.

Minor: Forward the q query-string param from manuale.tsx into ManualBrowser as an initial text value so /manuale?q=scanner shows pre-populated search results, not just an autofocused empty box. Suggested patch: <ManualBrowser autoFocus={!!q} initialQuery={q ?? ''}/> and useState(initialQuery) + effect that calls search(initialQuery).
Minor: In manuale.tsx back-button fallback, replace router.replace('/help') with '/help-center' to match the canonical help route.

After the Anthropic key is fixed, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_v50z554_manual_assistant.py — the 4 how-to tests should pass. Also re-check the 'path mention' assertion: the current scanner-navigator reply format ('**Title** — desc\n[[NAV:/route|label]]') does NOT include an explicit 'Menu →' textual path, only the chip. If product requirement is that EVERY how-to reply must contain both a textual path AND a chip, the fast-path formatter in axon_navigator.py needs to prepend the '📍 PERCORSO: ...' line, or the manual-injection prompt rule needs to be enforced at the LLM level too.
critical_code_review_comments: axon_manual.py uses a module-level `_ARTICLES = _mn_articles()` snapshot built at import time — fine because MANUAL is a static Python literal, no reload concern.

`_mn_score()` stop-word filter is Italian-tuned; good coverage for the tested queries. Scores observed in /api/public/manual/search were strictly descending for every tested query (verified in parametrized test).

ManualBrowser.open() silently no-ops when resolveNavRoute(a.route) returns null — consider surfacing a toast 'Schermata non ancora collegata' so the user knows nothing happened. Currently the Apri button is simply hidden when route unresolvable (`canOpen` gate), which is OK.

The two configured LLM paths (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and direct ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) are both referenced in logs. With the current invalid ANTHROPIC_API_KEY the fallback should route through EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, but it does not; investigate axon.llm fallback logic — a bad direct key should trigger a graceful fallback to the Emergent key, not a hard offline message.

success_rate.backend: 76% (13/17 pytest; manual list+search 100%, assistant chat 25% due to LLM key)
success_rate.frontend: 60% (routing & chat FAB OK; manuale data empty on deployed stack due to VPS-not-deployed; q-param pre-fill bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Preview backend has V50.z554 deployed and healthy. Production VPS core.axonos.cloud does NOT — this is what the Expo web actually uses. 2) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env is invalid; litellm throws 'invalid x-api-key' on every Claude call → 'Sono temporaneamente offline' on 3/4 of the review's how-to prompts. 3) Only the axon_navigator.py programmatic fast-path (['dove trovo', 'apri', 'portami'] + known function kw) returns a working NAV chip without hitting Claude; this is why 'Dove trovo lo scanner biglietti da visita?' succeeded and the other three didn't. 4) After the main agent fixes the key (and ideally deploys the manual routes to the VPS), rerun /app/backend/tests/test_v50z554_manual_assistant.py — 4 how-to tests should flip to green. 5) Frontend test command used: direct navigation to /login with testids auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button; dismiss tour-skip; then goto /manuale.
rca_of_issue: Root cause 1 (empty manual): /app/frontend/src/api.ts BACKEND_URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL (https://core.axonos.cloud) takes priority over EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The V50.z554 manual routes exist in /app/backend/routes/axon_manual.py and are served correctly from the preview backend (verified: 200, 145 items, 10 categories) but return 404 on https://core.axonos.cloud/api/public/manual → the deployed Expo UI shows an empty /manuale. Reproduction: curl https://core.axonos.cloud/api/public/manual (404) vs curl https://business-card-pro-16.preview.emergentagent.com/api/public/manual (200, 145 items). Root cause 2 (how-to 'offline'): /app/backend/.env has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY='apikey_01A3Dnnn7WvZLVv7WaRWzBgE'. Anthropic requires 'sk-ant-...'; litellm raises AuthenticationError on every chat completion → axon.llm catches it and the assistant endpoint returns the AXON_OFFLINE_MSG from 19_axon_assistant_core.py. Reproduction: tail -n50 /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log | grep 'invalid x-api-key' — shows 2000+ occurrences. Mitigation: replace the key with a valid sk-ant-... value or ensure the fallback through EMERGENT_LLM_KEY runs on auth errors.
